prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated transparent RGBA paper prop atlas for Pokémon Emerald pop-up battle terrariums, landscape 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns and 3 rows with large transparent gutters.
Primary request: twelve exquisitely hand-cut paper props. Every object must look made of many thin flat overlapping colored paper cutouts: crisp cream cut edges, paper fibers, visible small layer offsets, delicate printed decorative details. Front stage view, slight upper-surface visibility. Strong readable silhouettes. NOT sculpted 3D, no photoreal objects, no thick low-poly blocks, no plastic. No backgrounds, ground patches, labels, text, border or shadows outside each object. Actual transparent background; every prop completely separate and fully inside its own cell.
Row 1 left to right: green bicycle with separate-looking thin cream wheel rims, spokes and kickstand; wooden park bench with teal metal armrests, slatted seat and carved paper grain; slim teal street lamp with amber glass lantern, ornamental gold trim and layered paper lightning emblem; low rectangular cream planter with a lush trimmed dark green hedge and tiny yellow flowers.
Row 2 left to right: short ornate ivory stone balustrade with three small columns and moss details; flowering tree with layered rose pink blossoms, individual leaf shapes, branching brown flat paper trunk; dense patch of pink and white five-petal flowers and long green leaves; ornate cream garden urn overflowing with pink flowers, gold trim and green paper vines.
Row 3 left to right: a single blue-and-gold swallowtail tournament pennant hanging vertically from a horizontal wooden rod at its top, with a simple white star emblem; two short polished teal posts linked by a looping golden rope, made of flat strips of paper; one isolated rose-pink flower petal for drifting animation; one isolated small bright yellow four-point electric spark with a cream inner paper layer for animation.
These are authored as movable individual paper stage props, with layered collage detail inside each silhouette. Careful refined paper illustration, harmonious colors, no joined scene.
